info.name: Mail OIDC Bridge
info.summary: Bridges user_oidc tokens with Mail app for XOAUTH2 authentication
info.description:
Bridges user_oidc tokens with Mail app for XOAUTH2 authentication.
Features: - Updates Mail provisioned accounts to use XOAUTH2 for OIDC users - Injects OIDC access tokens into mail accounts for XOAUTH2 authentication - Works with Mail app's native provisioning (Admin Settings > Groupware)
Requirements: - user_oidc app with store_login_token enabled - Mail app installed with provisioning configured - Mail server supporting OAuth2 authentication (XOAUTH2)
info.author: Sergio Serra
